title: See the Clues and Count the Answers · Session 1

slides.prompt: Today we do not write. What do we do?
slides.alt: Magnifying glass over a short list, signalling detective work
slides.hint: No sentences today. Only circles and boxes.
slides.notes: 0-5 hook. Chant find, circle, count twice; red pencil up on circle. Boxes only today; keep the three verbs on the wall all session.

slides.feedback: Essays go to the marker. No Dear. No From.
slides.notes: Circle ESSAY on paper. Reader is the marker. Park the Q59 trap: the teacher is IN that story but the reader is still the marker; prove it later.

slides.prompt: Do we write Dear Ali and From, Siti?
slides.feedback: These essays need no greeting and no sign-off.
slides.notes: Worksheet A item 4. All 60 tasks in this system are essays, so never add letter parts.

slides.hint: WHAT asks apa. WHEN asks bila. WHERE asks di mana.
slides.notes: Chorus each twice. Red pencil underlines the clue word in every later note. BM meanings are small support only.

slides.hint: WHO asks siapa. WHY asks mengapa. HOW asks bagaimana.
slides.notes: Repair HOW vs WHY: how to keep fit names the way; benefits name the reason. All six labels are reused on every later beat.

slides.prompt: Q1 Badminton Match: when and where, how played, result. How many?
slides.feedback: WHEN and WHERE are two boxes. HOW one. RESULT one.
slides.hint: Note 1 has AND. Two clue words?
slides.notes: Think aloud using only the six clue words. Cover WHERE and ask: WHEN alone is still an answer, so two boxes. Blue pencil TIME, red pencil PLACE. Four fingers.

slides.prompt: Split: a. when and where b. communication, learning c. wash hands or sanitise.
slides.answer: a. TIME and PLACE. b. COMMUNICATION and LEARNING. c. Choose one action.
slides.feedback: AND and commas add answers. OR asks you to choose.
slides.hint: a is AND. b is comma. c is OR.
slides.notes: Repair counting OR as two: OR means one action done well. Repair merging comma lists into one blob. The fourth split, what you saw and bought, stays on the worksheet to avoid overload.

slides.prompt: Keep Fit: eat balanced food, exercise, get sleep. How many answers?
slides.feedback: No question mark still counts. Every note is compulsory.
slides.hint: Each line starts with a doing-word.
slides.notes: Underline the doing-words in red. Contrast with OR: no choice here, all three count. Bridge: three answers, but what kind of writing? That is the job card.

slides.prompt: Show the card: PAST, FACT, PLAN or ADVICE?
slides.hint: Find the signal word in each prompt.
slides.notes: Hold-up check, six prompts: a trip you enjoyed PAST; benefits of reading FACT; your future creation PLAN; how to keep fit ADVICE; took part in a badminton match PAST; Eat balanced food ADVICE. Repair benefits vs advice: benefits TELLS a fact, advice TELLS what to do. Keep the four cards on the wall.

slides.prompt: Use this page during the race.

columns.label: Find and split
columns.text: WHAT thing, WHEN time, WHERE place, WHO person, WHY reason, HOW way. AND adds, comma adds, OR chooses.

columns.label: Job and reader
columns.text: PAST took part, FACT benefits, PLAN will, ADVICE how to. Reader is the marker.

slides.hint: Point to the line you use.
slides.notes: Synthesis reference before application: all six clues, three split rules, four jobs and the reader rule together. No new teaching and no Q17 or Q59 answers here. Optional 60-second mask-and-recall game.

slides.prompt: Pair race. Targets 8, then 4. No sentences.
slides.alt: Trophy signalling a pair counting race
slides.hint: Keep the reference open. Point to each line.
slides.notes: Timer about three minutes per race. Pairs circle, split and count only. Synthesis reference stays open. Hardest count first.

slides.text: Badminton vs Table Tennis. Badminton: very popular, good facilities, established internationally. Table tennis: not so popular, can play at home, not much success. Which do you choose, and why?
slides.hint: Each comma item is one answer. Choice and reason add two.
slides.notes: Dataset maximum. Expect eight boxes: three badminton facts, three table-tennis facts, choice plus reason. Repair merging popularity across games, and dropping the reason.

slides.feedback: Three facts each, plus your choice and reason.
slides.notes: Reveal the eight-way split. Choice WITHOUT reason is half the last two marks: WHY always needs its own box.

slides.prompt: Q59 Farewell Gathering: who she is, inspiration, debate help, wish. Count?
slides.feedback: She is the topic. The marker still reads it.
slides.hint: She is the TOPIC. Who MARKS it?
slides.notes: Four boxes plus NO to reader-is-teacher. No Dear and no you: her name goes in a WHO box. SHE sentence bricks belong to Session 2, not now. Copy debating team accurately.

slides.prompt: Exit check. Alone. Circles and boxes only.
slides.alt: Clipboard with ticks signalling an independent check
slides.hint: Reader, job, boxes, total. Two sets.
slides.notes: Reference closed. Set A trip: WHEN+WHERE two, SAW+BOUGHT two, felt one, total five, job PAST. Set B hands: OR chooses one, balanced food one, sleep one, total three, job ADVICE. Four minutes strict.

slides.answer: Set A: 5 points, job PAST. Set B: 3 points, job ADVICE.
slides.feedback: AND and commas add. OR chooses one.
slides.notes: Mark five per set: reader one, job one, splits and counts, clue labels. Mastery eight of ten including one exact compound count. Below threshold gets a five-minute re-sort in Session 2; keep that list private.
